title: MIMECRAFT!
description: This mod adds Mime from the Roblox game Grace to follow you around.
body:
![mimereal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e934cca3d5ab25af7940d31cf6f8ee03f7b0ba41.png)

# Introduction
Mimecraft is a mod based on the Roblox game Grace. It adds one character - that being Mime.
If you would like a good challenge for your world, give this mod a go.

# Gameplay
After spawning in the world, Mime will descend directly above you. It instantly kills on contact.

Attempting to kill it, you will find that it has infinite health. 

That's right - Mime is unkillable. The only thing you can do is hit, or "flash" it, to delay it a little.

Mime can see you from over 2,000 blocks away, and hiding in buildings will not save you - it will wait patiently outside.

# Important
- Go play Grace, it's an excellent game.
- Sound effects are NOT mine; all credit goes to the creator of Grace.
